RFC7770-2.4-1.note: Forbidden: the type-1 Informational Capabilities TLV not being the first TLV of Instance 0. ri_test.go TestRITLVType1First registers a type-8 builder, decodes buildRIInstances(area scope, backbone)[0] (Instance 0) and fails unless decoded[0].Type is RITLVInformationalCapabilities. Re-judged 2026-09-30 after the call site gained the (area, iface) scope target; the assertion is unchanged. Single-polarity marker on the row covers the absent negative.

RFC7770-2.4-2.note: Area scope is enforced both ways: rfc7770_ri_scope_test.go TestRFC7770AreaRICapabilitiesFollowTheArea fails if the backbone RI LSA (TE on eth0 in area 0) leaves TE clear or the area 0.0.0.5 RI LSA (no TE interface) sets it; revert records on ri.go::areaHasTE (+) and ri.go::deriveRICapabilities (-) observed red. AS scope: TestRICapabilityBitsFromState (-, no TE) and TestRICapabilityTEBitFromConfig (+) hold, unrecorded. Missing: (1) the link-scope branch of riScopeHasTE has no assertion, so returning the router-wide answer for a Type-9 RI LSA survives every test; (2) at AS scope a router-address alone (HasTERouterAddress, no active TE interface) claims TE although teOriginateType1 originates no TE LSA (anyTEActive false), and TestRICapabilityTEBitFromConfig sets both, so neither source is isolated.

RFC7770-2.6-1.note: Forbidden: the type-2 Functional Capabilities TLV carried outside the first instance. ri_registry_test.go TestRITLVRegistered requires buildRIInstances(area scope, backbone) to return exactly one instance whose TLV types are [1, 2, 8], so type-2 is in Instance 0. Re-judged 2026-09-30 after the call-site signature change; assertion unchanged. Single-polarity marker on the row covers the absent negative.

RFC7770-2.6-2.note: Forbidden: advertising a functional capability Ze does not have. Re-judged 2026-09-30 after the call-site signature change; assertion unchanged. Single-polarity marker on the row covers the absent negative.
